name: athena-sky
description: Athena-sky: cloud platform for drone fleet management, 3D mission planning, real-time LTE control & video, flight logs with AI analytics and integrated UTM.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @athena-sky/web && npm run build -w @athena-sky/server && npm run build -w @athena-sky/simulator
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/simulator --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
